lines.text: Boris the badger woke up on the prickly side of his underground den!
He scowled at the morning sun and grunted at every animal he passed on the trail!
Soon, all the forest birds stopped singing and the chipmunks scurried away into trees!
Being grumpy made the whole forest feel chilly, cloudy, and lonely!
Then little Pippin the bunny hopped up and beamed a gigantic, warm, goofy smile!
Boris tried to stay mad, but the cheerful smile tickled his whiskers like warm sunshine!
A tiny chuckle escaped his snout, then grew into a roaring belly laugh!
Smiles are like magic boomerangs—the more you give, the more bounce right back!
